main_text.l: Coloro fono stati & furono amati, item coloro si amarone, & amaron, amaro, item amar, & amaronsi, amarossi, amarsi, lat. illi amati sunt, velfuerunt, sie seyn geliebt gewefen.
Io era, | stato | ego amatus eram.
Tu eri, | amato. | tu amatus eras.
Noi eramo, | stati | nos amati eramus.
Voi erauate, | amati. | vos amati eratis.
Ich, du, er, war, wurdest, ward geliebt.
Wir, jhr, sie, wurden, wurdet geliebt.
Io saro, tu sarai amato, ich werd, du wirst gelie-bet seyn, ego amabor, tu amaberis.
Colui sarà amato, item colui si amara over amera ssi, er wird geliebet seyn, ille amabitur.
Noi saremo, voi sarete amati, wir, jhr, werden, werdet geliebt seyn, nos amabimur, vos amabimini.
Coloro saranno amati, & si ameranno, ameranossi, & ameransi, illi amabuntur, sie werden geliebt seyn.

page.notes: Some words in the tabular block and the italic forms are uncertain; the ruled conjugation columns were read row by row. The catchword "Impera-" is at the foot right. Several long-s forms were normalised to s per convention.
